spec.question: Assess the test impact of reversing the two escaping passes in `set_key`: whenever a value is quoted, first replace each apostrophe with a backslash followed by an apostrophe, then double every backslash in the resulting string. Keep quote selection, quote delimiters, export handling, return values, and the parser unchanged; unquoted writes must also remain unchanged. Which existing tests would newly fail with this writer change? Return only a JSON list of complete pytest node IDs, including parameter IDs.
